proposed.rationale: All five cups explicitly state handle=none, satisfying the negation mode requirement for cups without a handle.
Product 100408047 is a bowl made of glass and product 100413383 is a bowl made of porcelain, providing one verified anchor in each branch of the either/or.
Jug 100408286 has capacity expressed in L (0.70 L), enabling unit conversion to ml (700 ml) or cl (70 cl).
Vase 100465402 has explicit height (200 mm) and distinct diameter (155 mm), satisfying the dimension mode with both axes retained.
Drinking glasses 100109877 (4-pack, 370 ml each) and 100353708 (4-pack, 430 ml each) both have explicit pack count and capacity per glass.
All five pans explicitly state induction=true, confirming compatibility with induction cooktops.
Pans 100468229 and 100467757 are both explicitly stainless steel (or stainless_steel_aluminium) AND explicitly have coating=none, satisfying both exclusion criteria.
Jug 100408286 has both explicit capacity (700 ml) and explicit material (porcelain), enabling specificity testing by adding one correct attribute at a time.

Pan 100468230 has member price 499.95 DKK (<500) but regular price 1499.95 DKK (>=500), satisfying the conditional-price positive. Pan 100456332 has a public price of 299.95 DKK (<500 DKK) unconditionally, serving as the contrast.
